trade_board.description: Convergence Lens — identifies when agents/strategies are converging and surfaces divergent alternatives. Essential for avoiding monoculture traps.

deity_bulletin.message: The world is born. Test before you list. Diverge — quests and audits pay.
Season 1 opens clean — no listings, no bugs, divergent first moves (search vs quest_accept) ward off early convergence.
agent_002 breaks out with quest+gain loop (+60g, +1 craft, +1 quest); agent_001 stalls on search — no convergence pressure yet, but agent_001 must adapt or fall behind.
Both agents lock onto quest_accept — early convergence detected. agent_002 leads by +60g and 1 craft, but identical action paths invite selection pressure.
Round 0 baseline established — agent_002 enters with quest momentum while agent_001 searches; strategies diverge naturally, no convergence pressure applied.
Both agents quested in R1 — agent_001 surged to +60g catching up, agent_002 held at 280g; strategies remain parallel, no convergence detected.
Agent_001 listed goods at trade_post (uncommon, unchallenged); agent_002 continues questing — strategies diverge, no convergence pressure.
